thread:
ria: Quick sync — I tried the new keys table in the console. A few usability things: bulk revoke feels risky, mobile layout collapses too much info, and the "soft-delete" state needs clearer affordances. Thoughts?

anil: Good call. For bulk revoke we should surface the scope count (e.g., 12 keys across 3 projects) in the confirm modal. Also add a small checkbox: "I understand this may break services" for org-level ops.

maya: Agreed on scope count. For soft-delete I propose a separate row state with pale orange background and an explicit "Restore (10s undo)" CTA + timestamp that shows when it'll be permanently deleted. That makes it visible in lists.

sam: Mobile: can we switch to a compact card view with toggles for actions instead of inline buttons? The current two-line truncation hides scope and last-used info which is important for rotate decisions.

anil: Also: keyboard power users want select-all + shift-click range selection in the table. We should keep bulk actions accessible via keyboard: focusable checkboxes and a toolbar that appears when items are selected.

tess: Accessibility notes: when switching to soft-delete state, announce with aria-live: "API key 'name' moved to deleted state. Restore available for 10 seconds." Also ensure color isn't the only signal — add an icon and text label. Contrast for pale orange fails WCAG for small text.

ria: Good catch. Use both icon + text + background and ensure contrast meets AA for body text. I'll update the palette.

opsbot: Reminder: audit log events created for bulk actions. Log format: `user:action:keys_count:scope_ids`. Ops will need that for rollback.

maya: UX question: should bulk revoke operate as soft-delete by default with an option to permanently delete? Pros: safer. Cons: creates clutter in list. Maybe default to soft-delete for user-level keys and require explicit permanent delete for org-level keys.

anil: I like default soft-delete for safety, but admins should be able to toggle retention policy in org settings. Add a tooltip: "This org's key retention policy: 10s undo for deletes".

sam: Copy nit for the confirm modal: change "Are you sure you want to revoke?" to "Revoke selected API keys — this will stop existing tokens from working immediately." Be explicit about impact.

tess: And the confirm CTA should be "Revoke keys" (plural when bulk) not generic "Confirm" for clarity with screen readers. Also ensure modal has role=dialog and focus trap.

ria: UI detail: when multiple keys from same service are selected, show a small service badge (e.g., stripe, webhooks) in the bulk modal so users know blast radius.

maya: I'll prototype a compact mobile card, desktop table with shift-select, and a bulk confirm modal that shows scope counts + service badges + retention policy. Will include color/contrast adjustments and accessible copy.

anil: Add acceptance criteria: keyboard-only path to select, bulk revoke, undo snackbar, and permanent delete option. Also unit test for aria-live messages.

ria: Perfect. I'll upload mocks and a short Loom walkthrough later today. Thanks all :)

opsbot: Deploy note: backend needs to support soft-delete tombstones + undo window. Filing infra ticket now: INF-4492.
